description: This file defines the ResetPasswordDao class which manages database operations related to password reset requests, including saving requests, retrieving logs by email or reset code, and updating the expiration status of reset requests.

classes.name: ResetPasswordDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class responsible for handling CRUD operations related to password reset requests in the database.

methods.name: saveResetPasswordRequest
methods.description: Persists a new ResetPasswordRequest entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getResetPasswordLogByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent ResetPasswordRequest log for a given email address.

methods.name: getResetPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ResetPasswordRequest log based on a specific reset code.

methods.name: updateResetPasswordValid
methods.description: Updates the 'expired' status of reset requests associated with a specific email.
